subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should OpenClaw core doctor leave schemaless external channel config untouched for this migration, or should external channels get an explicit opt-in migration contract first?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but the remaining choice is the compatibility boundary for external plugin config repair during shipped upgrades.

options.title: Accept Schema-Verified Guard
options.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write groupAllowFrom unless bundled metadata proves the schema accepts it.

options.title: Add External Opt-In
options.body: Pause and add a plugin doctor/schema capability so non-bundled channels can opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Wait For Broader Protection
options.body: Supersede this PR only if broader config-protection work lands the same email/RCS regression behavior and coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept Schema-Verified Guard
recommendation.body: Merge after normal gates if maintainers agree core doctor must not write groupAllowFrom unless bundled metadata proves the schema accepts it.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, making it the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary decision.
